div.div:
Why pgvector and not the blueprint's Elasticsearch backend: our ES is 7.17 and has no native kNN — upgrading ES touches es-mappings, es-client-starter and 11 index definitions.
Why not Milvus: a new container plus etcd for a corpus of a few thousand chunks. pgvector = one image swap and one Flyway migration (needs spring-boot-flyway on the classpath under SB4).
Corpus is 10³–10⁴ chunks; pgvector HNSW is comfortable to ~10⁶.
